options.content:
### FLEET HEALTH · ALL WINDOWS SERVERS  
**Find trouble first.** Click a server name in the table to open its CPU, RAM, GPU, disk and networking details. [Open single-server dashboard](/d/server-health/windows-server-health-connectivity).  
**Status:** 0 = healthy, 2 = warning, 3 = critical resources, 4 = exporter or ICMP check failed. Missing metrics are not automatically scored as healthy.

spec.title: Monitored
spec.description: Total Windows exporters registered as Prometheus targets

spec.title: Healthy
spec.description: No warning/critical threshold found in available metrics; missing sensors are not validated

spec.expr:
count((max by (host) (
  label_replace((4 * min by (host) (up{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"} == bool 0)), "signal", "exporter-down", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * min by (host) (probe_success{job="icmp-ping",host=~"$host"} == bool 0)), "signal", "ping-failed", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((3 * ((100 * (1 - avg by (host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_seconds_total{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",mode="idle"}[5m])))) >= bool 90)), "signal", "cpu-critical", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * ((100 * (1 - avg by (host) (rate(windows_cpu_time_seconds_total{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",mode="idle"}[5m])))) >= bool 75)), "signal", "cpu-warning", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((3 * ((100 * (1 - max by (host) (windows_memory_available_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"}))) >= bool 90)), "signal", "ram-critical", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * ((100 * (1 - max by (host) (windows_memory_available_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"} / windows_memory_physical_total_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"}))) >= bool 80)), "signal", "ram-warning", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((3 * ((max by (host) (100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",volume=~"[A-Za-z]:"} / (windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",volume=~"[A-Za-z]:"} > 0)))) >= bool 90)), "signal", "disk-critical", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * ((max by (host) (100 * (1 - windows_logical_disk_free_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",volume=~"[A-Za-z]:"} / (windows_logical_disk_size_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",volume=~"[A-Za-z]:"} > 0)))) >= bool 80)), "signal", "disk-warning", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * ((max by (host) (100 * rate(windows_net_bytes_total{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"}[5m]) / (windows_net_current_bandwidth_bytes{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"} > 0))) >= bool 90)), "signal", "nic-high", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((3 * ((max by (host) (clamp_max(100 * sum by (host,phys) (rate(windows_gpu_engine_time_seconds_total{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",engtype="3D"}[5m])),100))) >= bool 98)), "signal", "gpu-critical", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * ((max by (host) (clamp_max(100 * sum by (host,phys) (rate(windows_gpu_engine_time_seconds_total{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host",engtype="3D"}[5m])),100))) >= bool 90)), "signal", "gpu-warning", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((3 * ((max by (host) (windows_gpu_temperature_celsius{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"})) >= bool 90)), "signal", "gpu-temp-critical", "host", ".*")
  or
  label_replace((2 * ((max by (host) (windows_gpu_temperature_celsius{job="windows-servers",host=~"$host"})) >= bool 80)), "signal", "gpu-temp-warning", "host", ".*")
)) == 0) or vector(0)

spec.title: Fullest 20 volumes · fleet capacity watch
spec.description: A full volume may be critical even when the host appears otherwise healthy. Drive-letter volumes only.

spec.title: Busiest NIC percentage · top 12
spec.description: 5-minute traffic as percentage of interface link speed

spec.title: Windows exporter and ping history · last selected time window
spec.description: Green is good; red = exporter scrape / ping failure. Gaps mean a sample was missing; they do not prove downtime. Choose last 24h to review overnight outages.

options.content: **How to use:** The main table ranks potential issues (4 exporter scrape failed, 3 critical resource, 2 warning including ping failure, 0 no threshold breached). Click a **Server** link to examine its individual dashboard. Physical GPU counters are optional. **Ping unavailable does not mean Windows Exporter is down**, and vice versa; compare both before investigating network access. These are dashboard colour thresholds, not notification rules. For true alerting use Prometheus/Grafana alert rules with sustained durations.
